title: Vaal Temple: 9x9 Grid, Architect and the Route to Atziri
summary: How the Vaal Temple works in Path of Exile 2: earning Energised Crystals, placing rooms on the 9x9 grid, reaching the Architect, unlocking Royal Access and the route into Atziri's Chamber.
description: A walkthrough of the Vaal Temple in Path of Exile 2: Crystal economy, grid connectivity rules, room types and upgrades, the Architect route, Royal Access and the Atziri approach.
prerequisites: Access to the Atlas and a source of Vaal Beacons
Understanding of map device and Temple Hub
Patience for a step-by-step build, not a speed run
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Atziri, the Red Queen, reached through the Vaal Temple in Path of Exile 2

items.title: What is the Vaal Temple?
body: The Vaal Temple is an endgame structure you build room by room on a 9x9 grid using Energised Crystals earned from the Atlas.
Completed temples can lead to the Architect and, eventually, Atziri's Chamber.

items.title: Where do Crystals come from?
body: Energised Crystals are earned by engaging with Vaal content on the Atlas, typically through Vaal-focused mechanics and Beacon drops.

items.title: How do I reach Atziri?
body: You must build a connected path through the grid to the Architect Chamber, then unlock Royal Access, which opens the route into Atziri's Chamber.

items.title: What if my layout breaks?
body: If rooms no longer connect, you can repair the path, finish the current temple, or start a new one; the right choice depends on how much is already built.

sections.title: Unlocking and earning Crystals
paragraphs: The Temple Hub is where you manage the build. Vaal Beacons and Energised Crystals fuel room placement; without Crystals you cannot expand the grid.
Crystals accumulate from Vaal-flavoured Atlas content. Treat them as a budget: each room placement spends Crystals, so plan before you build.
Do not enter the Temple to fight until you have placed the rooms you need; some layouts are easier to complete in one pass than to fix later.

sections.title: The Temple interface
paragraphs: The grid is 9x9 with a fixed entrance and a build direction. Each cell shows whether it is empty, occupied, or a special node.
Room cards display their entrances and exits. Two rooms only connect if a facing entrance meets a facing exit on adjacent cells.
The interface also tracks your main path, branches, and any unreachable region so you can see problems before committing.

sections.title: Planning the 9x9 grid
paragraphs: Start from the entrance and grow a single main path toward your target chamber. Branches are optional and can strand if not careful.
Keep the main path priority high; once it reaches the Architect or Royal Access, side rooms are bonuses, not requirements.
Avoid boxing yourself in: leaving no adjacent empty cell for a needed room type is the most common way to break a layout.

sections.title: Connectivity rules
paragraphs: Rooms connect only through matching entrance/exit facings on adjacent cells. A room whose only exit faces a wall or an empty cell goes nowhere.
You cannot connect two rooms that are diagonally adjacent; connectivity is orthogonal only.
If a room appears unreachable, check the cell between it and the path, not the room itself.

steps.label: Build toward the Architect Antechamber
body: Place rooms so the main path reaches the Architect chamber entrance.

steps.label: Complete the Architect encounter
body: Clear the chamber to register Architect progress for the temple.

steps.label: Confirm the node is marked done
body: The interface should show the Architect as reached before you build past it.

steps.label: Reach the Royal Antechamber
body: Route the main path into the Royal Antechamber cell.

steps.label: Satisfy its unlock condition
body: Royal Access typically requires the Architect to be done first; verify the prerequisite is met.

steps.label: Open the Royal Access Chamber
body: Once unlocked, the Royal route becomes available for Atziri's Gate.

steps.label: Connect Atziri's Gate
body: Build a continuous path from the entrance through Royal Access to Atziri's Gate.

steps.label: Enter the chamber
body: Atziri's Chamber opens only with the full connected route; partial paths will not trigger it.

steps.label: Fight Atziri
body: The boss page covers Atziri's attacks; this guide only handles reaching the chamber.

sections.title: Why is my layout broken?
sections.intro: Pick your symptom and where it happens to find the fix.

rules.title: Unreachable room near entrance
steps: Check the cell between the entrance and the room; the facing exit must point at the room's entrance.

rules.title: Dead-end in the middle
steps: The room's only exit faces a wall or empty cell; add a connecting room or reroute the main path.

rules.title: Target will not open
steps: Confirm the full prerequisite chain (Architect then Royal Access) is complete and the path is continuous.

defaultResult.title: General recovery
steps: Finish the current temple for whatever rewards are banked, then start a fresh layout with the main path planned first.

sections.title: Recover, repair or reset?
sections.intro: Decide based on how much is already built.

rows.when: Only one or two rooms are misplaced
Target is unreachable but partial value exists
The grid is too broken to fix cheaply

sections.title: Reward planning
paragraphs: Prioritise rooms that advance the Architect and Royal Access chain; decorative or economy rooms are secondary until the path is secure.
Vaal Orbs and Architect's Orbs are typical temple rewards; decide whether you need them before investing Crystals in side rooms.
Once Atziri is reachable, the temple's job is done; you can close it without building every optional room.

sections.title: What players report
sections.intro: Community experiences; strategy, not guaranteed mechanics.

cards.title: Plan the main path first
body: Most failed temples skipped planning and boxed in the Architect chamber.

cards.title: Royal Access needs Architect
body: Players often report Royal Access not opening because the Architect was not completed first.

cards.title: Don't over-build
body: Reaching Atziri does not require every room; extra rooms waste Crystals.

sections.title: Common problems
paragraphs: If a room will not connect, check facings, not just adjacency; a wrong-facing exit is the usual cause.
If Royal Access will not open, confirm the Architect encounter was actually completed and registered.
If you closed the temple by mistake, the route is lost; you must build a new temple from the Hub.
